title: Guided: format a label

ticket.subject: Labels for the pallet board
ticket.body: Each pallet board line reads "name: count items". Trim spaces around the name.

rules: Return the name, then a colon, a space, the count, and the word items.
Remove spaces from both ends of the name.

title: Guided: count shipments by mode

ticket.subject: Shipments per mode
ticket.body: Each record has a "mode" key. Count how many records each mode has. An empty export gives an empty count.

rules: Count each record under its mode.
An empty list gives an empty dict, not None.

title: Guided: classify a parcel weight

ticket.subject: Weight bands
ticket.body: Under 5 kg is light. From 5 to 20 kg, including both ends, is medium. Above 20 kg is heavy.

rules: From 5 to 20 kg, including 5 and 20, is "medium".

title: Guided: send parcels in batches

ticket.subject: Batches of parcels
ticket.body: Give the parcel list in batches of a given size. Each batch holds 1 to size items, in order. An empty list gives no batches.

rules: Each batch holds between 1 and size items, and the last batch may be shorter.
The items keep their order, both between batches and inside each batch.
An empty input gives no batches.
